mapper.select: select count(*) from tbl_user where userid=#{userid}
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_user(userid, name, passwd, tel, email, gubun) values(#{userid}, #{name}, #{passwd}, #{tel}, #{email}, #{gubun})
mapper.select: select * from tbl_user where userid=#{userid} and passwd=#{passwd}
mapper.update: update tbl_user set last_time=sysdate where userid=#{userid}
update tbl_user set passwd=#{passwd}, tel=#{tel}, email=#{email}, gubun=#{gubun} where userid=#{userid}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from tbl_pds where name=#{name}) as pdssubject, (select count(*) from tbl_board where name=#{name}) as boardsubject, (select count(*) from tbl_boardphoto where name=#{name}) as boardphotosubject, (select count(*) from tbl_pds where name=#{name}) + (select count(*) from tbl_board where name=#{name}) + (select count(*) from tbl_boardphoto where name=#{name}) as totsubject from dual
